meta.title: SafeSpark - Confidential Support & Legal Protection Platform
meta.description: Discreet emergency distress reporting, 24/7 AI legal assistant, and empathetic therapy support.

common.emergencyNotice: If you are in immediate physical danger, please call 112 or 1091 directly.

language.persistedNotice: Your language choice is stored securely on this device and cleared during Quick Exit.

firstVisitModal.title: Welcome to SafeSpark
firstVisitModal.subtitle: Please select your preferred language for safety guidance and voice support.
firstVisitModal.note: You can change your language anytime using the language selector at the top.

sos.title: Discreet Emergency SOS Report
sos.subtitle: Submit your distress report securely. Your location and information are encrypted and sent to verified protection officers.
sos.speakingNotice: Listening... Speak naturally (e.g., 'My name is Sunita, I live in Pune...')
sos.voiceWarning: Voice can be overheard. You can type instead.
sos.namePlaceholder: Enter your name or safe pseudonym
sos.situationPlaceholder: Describe what happened, any threats made, or immediate dangers...
sos.culpritPlaceholder: Describe relation, appearance, weapon presence, or known identity...
sos.directSave: Submit Emergency Report & Go to Dashboard
sos.aiFilledNotice: Fields marked with were filled by voice. Please review before submitting.

lawbot.title: Legal Protection Assistant (LawBot)
lawbot.subtitle: Confidential AI guidance on Indian domestic violence laws, PWDVA 2005, BNS, and your statutory rights.
lawbot.inputPlaceholder: Ask a question about your legal rights or protections...
lawbot.disclaimer: LawBot provides legal information, not formal attorney representation. In an emergency, dial 112 or 1091.

therapy.title: Maya • SafeSpark Companion
therapy.subtitle: A safe, trauma-informed sanctuary for emotional grounding, breathwork, and confidential listening.
therapy.inputPlaceholder: Type how you are feeling or what you are experiencing...
therapy.chatPlaceholder: Type how you are feeling or what you are experiencing...

dashboard.title: Confidential Case Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Monitor and review encrypted emergency reports and official dispatch updates.

hero.eyebrow: এক নীৰৱ ঢাল | এক শক্তিশালী কণ্ঠ | ১০০% এনক্ৰিপ্টেড
hero.subtitle: সহায় লওক, আপোনাৰ অধিকাৰ জানক আৰু নীৰৱে আৰু সুৰক্ষিতভাৱে নিয়ন্ত্ৰণ লওক।
hero.cardSilenceTitle: ভাৰত জুৰি এক লুকাই থকা সংকট।
hero.cardSilenceBody: বহু মহিলাই হাৰাশাস্তি, অত্যাচাৰ আৰু হিংসাৰ সম্মুখীন হয় — প্ৰায়ে নীৰৱে।
hero.cardOneInThreeBody: ভাৰতত মহিলাসকলে কোনো না কোনো ৰূপত হিংসাৰ অভিজ্ঞতা লাভ কৰে।
hero.cardKnowBody: আইন, আপোনাৰ অধিকাৰ আৰু সহায় বিকল্পৰ বিষয়ে জানক।
hero.qaReportBody: গাৰ্হস্থ্য হিংসা বা হাৰাশাস্তি সুৰক্ষিতভাৱে প্ৰতিবেদন কৰক।
hero.qaLawbotBody: সহজ ভাষাত আইনী প্ৰশ্নৰ উত্তৰ লওক।
hero.qaDirectoryBody: বিশ্বাসযোগ্য হেল্পলাইন, আশ্ৰয় আৰু সেৱা বিচাৰক।
hero.qaTherapyBody: যেতিয়াই প্ৰয়োজন, কথা পাতিবলৈ এটা সুৰক্ষিত ঠাই।
